support_spans: nonindurated and well-defined 10 × 8-cm reddish-brown annular plaque with peripheral ecchymosis
Ki-67 index showed low proliferation in endothelial cells
contradict_spans: No cellular pleomorphism, mitotic figures, or intravascular red blood cells
concepts.why: The presence of a large, well-defined plaque with peripheral ecchymosis and low endothelial cell proliferation suggests angiosarcoma, but the lack of cellular pleomorphism and mitotic figures contradicts this diagnosis.
